text:
Omar: Quick heads-up 7am office lore question: who put the tiny ceramic gnome on the fridge?
Bea: that would be me. He was lonely. I named him 'Gnorman'.
Kai: Gnorman has been moved three times and now watches the snack shelf. Protective little guy.
Tori: note: gnomes require ceremonial potato offering on Mondays. It's in the unwritten handbook.
Omar: did not know this. Should we draft a gnome covenant?
Bea: covenant clause 1: do not microwave raw potatoes in office. Clause 2: always replace the milk.
Kai: addendum: anyone who steals Gnorman will be subjected to mild public shaming and forced to sing the fridge anthem.
Tori: I propose tiny felt cape for Gnorman. It will boost morale.
SnackBot: reminder: community snacks belong to everyone. Please log contributions.
Omar: poll: cape color: maroon or teal? React :one: maroon, :two: teal.
Bea: maroon for dignity. Teal for chaos.
Kai: maroon it is. I'm sewing it after lunch.
Tori: future historians: the Gnome Accord of 2026 begins. Archive in #random-lore.
Omar: also, who left a sticky note on Gnorman that said 'watch the hummus'? Charming.
Bea: hummus is safe. Gnorman's primary duty: watch snacks, inspire small acts of whimsy.
Kai: end of thread: long live Gnorman. All hail the fridge guardian. :mushroom:
